items.name: tokens
items.title: Tokens
items.author: s1lin
items.description: The tokens every part is drawn in: paper, ink, two greys, two hairlines, one accent, five typefaces and the "+" registration marks, as --s1- CSS variables, light and dark.

items.name: cn
items.title: cn
items.author: s1lin
items.description: Class names joined, the falsy ones dropped: clsx, under the name shadcn's parts use.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The house buttons: a hairline box in mono type, the same in ink with an offset shadow for the one thing to do, a pill, and words underlined; a size down; a link that looks the part.
items.author: s1lin

items.name: section-label
items.title: SectionLabel
items.description: A section's label: mono caps over a strong hairline, a word in Japanese first; it draws in from the left as it scrolls into view.
items.author: s1lin

items.name: kicker
items.title: Kicker
items.description: The line over a heading: a Japanese label in mincho, then the rest in spaced mono caps.
items.author: s1lin

items.name: roundel
items.title: Roundel
items.description: A metro-style station roundel: a line's letter in a ring, sized to the type around it.
items.author: s1lin

items.name: folio
items.title: Folio
items.description: A page number, "— 04 —", centred at the foot of its box, as on a printed page.
items.author: s1lin

items.name: barcode
items.title: Barcode
items.description: An id as a barcode drawn from its hex digits, the id printed under it.
items.author: s1lin

items.name: stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: A line of small hairline tags in mono: what something is built with.
items.author: s1lin

items.name: screen
items.title: Screen
items.description: A screenshot in a hairline browser frame: a bar with three dots and the address, an offset plate behind.
items.author: s1lin

items.name: plate
items.title: Plate
items.description: A box in a strong hairline with a "+" registration mark at each corner, as on a drawing sheet.
items.author: s1lin

items.name: mark
items.title: Mark
items.description: The mark, a cross on a block of ink, and the same set out with compass and square.
items.author: s1lin

items.name: ascii-art
items.title: AsciiArt
items.description: An ascii.rest piece: a <pre> that holds a still frame until the piece starts, or a canvas for pieces in colour.
items.author: s1lin
items.docs: Pieces come from ascii.rest: import * as typewriter from "ascii.rest/pieces/typewriter". For box-drawing characters in JetBrains Mono, declare the "ascii.rest mono" font (see ascii-art.css).

items.name: tex
items.title: Tex
items.description: LaTeX set by KaTeX, inline or on a line of its own; finished HTML from a server, or set in the browser when the formula mounts.
items.author: s1lin
items.docs: Import KaTeX's stylesheet on the pages that show maths: import "katex/dist/katex.min.css". To set maths on a server, call setKatex(katex) once before rendering.

items.name: use-near
items.title: useNear
items.description: True while an element is within a margin of the viewport; false on the server and the first render. Mount heavy things on it.
items.author: s1lin

items.name: use-media
items.title: useMedia
items.description: A media query's answer, kept current; false on the server.
items.author: s1lin

items.name: use-dark
items.title: useDark
items.description: True on night paper, read as the tokens read it: data-theme, a dark or light class, data-mode, else the system.
items.author: s1lin

items.name: use-hydrated
items.title: useHydrated
items.description: False in server HTML and while hydrating, true after: for output only a browser should make.
items.author: s1lin

items.name: use-scale
items.title: useScale
items.description: CSS pixels per unit of a drawing so many units wide, for words that must hold their size as an SVG scales.
items.author: s1lin
